analogy.rationale: NOS inhibition blocks NO production, opposing cGMP signaling and producing little transcriptional change in these cells, which express NOS isoforms at low levels; drugs acting on the NO-cGMP axis (guanylate cyclase, phosphodiesterase) or related redox/inflammatory pathways should give the most similar weak responses.
